problem: The image at 1.910 MHz is stated to be 0.900 MHz above the passband centre at 1.000 MHz. The correct distance is 1.910 − 1.000 = 0.910 MHz. The stated number is wrong by 10 kHz and contradicts the 2fIF = 0.910 MHz used earlier in the same example.
fix: The image at 1.910 MHz is 0.910 MHz above the passband centre and far outside the 0.990 MHz to 1.010 MHz passband.

problem: The formula block gives fLO = fRF + fIF and fimage = fRF + 2fIF before any mention of high-side injection. A student reading the box first can take these as general formulas, which they are not; the high-side condition is only stated in the next paragraph.
fix: Label the box explicitly: High-side injection (LO above the signal): fLO = fRF + fIF, fimage = fRF + 2fIF. Then give the low-side version in the next paragraph as now.

problem: "In AM broadcast it is commonly 455 kHz. Some syllabi call this the superhet receiver." placed back to back makes "this" look as if it points to the 455 kHz IF, so the sentence reads like 455 kHz is called the superhet receiver.
fix: Move the naming sentence earlier, before the IF value, for example: "This plan is what some syllabi call the superhet receiver. In AM broadcast the IF is commonly 455 kHz."
